title: Understanding Bootstrapping
text: Bootstrapping involves resampling with replacement from a dataset to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic. Think about how the shape of this distribution might change as you increase the sample size.

title: Normal Distribution and Sample Size
text: Consider what happens to the distribution of sample means as the sample size increases. Does it always become normal, or are there conditions that affect this?

title: Sample Size and Distribution Shape
text: As the sample size increases, does the distribution of the sample mean always become normal?
